source.offset: Harmonized BOA offsets already applied; raw DN times 1e-4

opticalRules.rgb: Display-referred sRGB from actual B04/B03/B02, 2x exposure (not a sharpened image), 10m, use low frequency only on broad land. Preserve stock high-res, native terrain, fall/creek, snow, glacier/ice and rendered water.
opticalRules.material: class 0 preserve stock; 1 vegetated; 2 nonveg; 3 water; 4 snow/ice; source scene SCL plus valid bands, no category calls from index alone. SCL is 20m sampled to 10m.
opticalRules.ndsi: (B03-B11)/(B03+B11), identical algebra to MNDWI and not sufficient to separate snow/water. Raw signed int8 scale 1/120; -128 invalid. SWIR 20m nearest repeated, not actual 10m spectral detail.
opticalRules.sourceLimits: Single date 2025-08-21; not survey or real-time terrain. Preserve authored shore/ice unless concurrent geometric dataset verifies shape. No full newer ortho / replacement DEM integrated.

source.zero: ambiguous: no canopy or not observed; never clear stock vegetation from zero
source.attribution: Version 2 High Resolution Canopy Height Maps by WRI and Meta
source.native: Approx. 1m modeled product; bounded official COG reads, nearest-neighbor onto game 4m grid

canopy.rule: Optical positive NDVI and SCL 4, height-model agreement; stock plants and terrain protected.

ortho.validMaskCodec: row major little bit order packed bitset, zlib base64
ortho.license: No restrictions, Maine GeoLibrary ArcGIS item licenseInfo
ortho.attribution: Maine Department of Environmental Protection; James W. Sewall; Bluesky Geospatial
ortho.timing: 2025 Coastal Acadia aerial imagery collection label; exact pixel acquisition date not verified; service includes an anomalous 2026 date
ortho.usage: Low-tide aerial survey. Clip to native game dry land and feather patch; retain actual dynamic water, authored nearshore materials and survey geometry. Do not bake captured foam, water, or alter DEM line.

source.rowOrder: north to south; columns west to east
source.vertical: NAVD88 (Geoid18) meters per project metadata; no vertical shift in GDAL, horizontal-only reprojection. Use stable dry anchors to calibrate relationship to stock model.
source.outputResampling: bounded GDAL read, bilinear reprojected to registered 1m, centimetre quantization
source.collection: USGS ME_MidCoast_2021_B21 2021–2022 lidar hydroflattened bare-earth DEM; exact cell flight not resolved
source.limits: Likely overlaps stock 3DEP input; not a new epoch claim. Some triangulated or low/negative cells are hydrographic; exclude wet/low and avoid coastline, structures/authoritative stock patches. Accept only if recalibration and dry geometry tests support finer terrain without altering flight clearance. May be omitted.

terrain.rule: Tiny dry local refinement; shared geometric and clearance height; no shift of any water, shoreline, wet or existing coastal survey terrain.
